articles.title: U.S. senators urge Treasury not to leave states out of GENIUS Act stablecoin process
articles.snippet: Senators led by Republican Cynthia Lummis are insisting the Treasury Department ensure states get a process to prove their ability to supervise stablecoins.

articles.title: Hyperliquid, Uniswap and Worldcoin buck crypto slump as traders chase AI, DeFi trends
articles.snippet: A handful of tokens continued their run while bitcoin and the rest of the crypto market stalled after the early week bounce.

articles.title: Coinbase intoduces AI advisor, stock options, and pre-IPO markets in finance push
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange is expanding into investing, derivatives and banking services as it pursues an all-in-one financial platform.

articles.title: Ripple invests in Flutterwave, pushing its stablecoin and XRP Ledger into payments across Africa
articles.snippet: The deal values Flutterwave at $3.2 billion, and will integrate Ripple's RLUSD and the XRP Ledger network to speed cross-border payments across Africa.

articles.title: Coinbase to join tokenized stock race with onchain shares, dividend payments
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange said investors will own the shares and receive dividends, underscoring growing momentum behind tokenized securities.
